abstract: Maintains seabed survey speed rate benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Marine geophysics lead (MGL), responsible for maintaining seabed survey speed rate benchmarks and overseeing geophysical mapping performance logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Magnetic anomaly mapping（MAG）
information_points.content:
MGL-MAG-OAB：Under the Tethered crawler inspection plan, calibration logs for the towed ferrous detection suite report a Fluxgate magnetometer sensitivity of 2 nT.
MGL-MAG-KN7：Under the Autonomous bathymetric survey plan, the towed ferrous detection suite demonstrates a Fluxgate magnetometer sensitivity of 5 nT for subsea ferromagnetic variance detection.
MGL-MAG-WMT：Under the Hybrid ROV acoustic profiling plan, the towed ferrous detection suite achieves a Fluxgate magnetometer sensitivity of 10 nT for minimum detectable subsea ferromagnetic variance.

information_points.title: Maintains seabed survey speed rate benchmarks（GEO）
information_points.content:
MGL-GEO-X25：For the Autonomous bathymetric survey plan, steady-state linear tracking distance traversed per hour during pipeline trench longitudinal tracking yields a Deepwater inspection rate of 4 km/h according to the high-resolution profiling performance log.
MGL-GEO-4SG：For the Hybrid ROV acoustic profiling plan, the high-resolution profiling performance log indicates a Deepwater inspection rate of 3 km/h based on steady-state longitudinal pipeline trench tracking.
MGL-GEO-1K3：For the Tethered crawler inspection plan, the high-resolution profiling performance log records a Deepwater inspection rate of 2 km/h across steady-state pipeline trench longitudinal tracking.
